Paragraph: "If you aspire my friendship here I extend my arm, take this hand of mine into yours, thus let the convention be stably made fast..." Thus Sugreeva proffered friendship to Rama.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Formalizing the alliance through a physical gesture of trust.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva extends his hand, proposing a firm, binding pact of friendship.
Outcome/Resolution: Establishing a concrete foundation for mutual trust.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Moving from apprehension to secure commitment

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Pani-grahana (sacred pledge of friendship through hand clasp)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Sealing a sacred bond of mutual support through a physical covenant.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Using physical gestures of trust to cement psychological safety and commitment.
